causal_findings.before: before-nested.txt: outer becomes pub fn sample() {} while nested retains use std::fmt;
causal_findings.after: after.txt: outer byte-identical, nested import removed, outcome file nested/src/lib.rs; root planner and separate command-directory planner both pass
causal_findings.counterexample: If the outer directory were the command directory, recorded ExecRequest.subdir would be empty. Both observed commands select nested.

causal_findings.before: before.txt: planner admits three files and both multipart outcomes; global guard errors outside checkout, valid.rs retains the import, for traversal and symlink cases
causal_findings.after: after.txt: planner emits one file, rejects entire unsafe multipart suggestion, public call succeeds and fixes valid.rs; source asserts outside.rs and src/lib.rs byte-identical
causal_findings.counterexample: If normalization already occurred before planning, the bad multipart would be skipped and would not reach the global workspace guard.

causal_findings.before: before.txt: initial green lint plus failed spawn, timeout, nonzero or missing exit returns Ok(true), with zero or one rewritten file; changed cases request an extra green lint
causal_findings.after: after.txt: terminal failure returns Err with command, status, output and pulled file count/names; main.py bytes match actual pulled changes; no extra lint masks failures
causal_findings.counterexample: If before.ok() were irrelevant to a failed fixer, no failed scripted fixer could return Ok(true).

coverage: 18 new tests plus 5 existing fixit tests. Includes inside parent components, canonical roots and aliases, overlap and stale-line guards, UTF-8, no partial multipart changes, all fixer failure modes with/without partial writes, successful fixer modes, no fix command and non-lint behavior with green/red initial reports.
unchanged_scope: No dependency, root Cargo, verification, exec, handler or unrelated worker changes. No manual sync, installs, restarts, publication, messages, delegation or commits.
